breakdown.description: The setup uses C3D20R elements, but the deck uses C3D6 elements.

breakdown.description: The setup assumes that the primary nodal load acts in the global z-direction, but the deck applies the concentrated load in the global x-direction.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies concentrated loads in the global x-direction (direction 1) with magnitude 6.25, matching the ground truth. The CLOAD section uses direction 1 (x-direction), and the spec explicitly states 'Apply concentrated loads in the global x-direction (direction 1),' overriding the incorrect instruction that loads act in the global z-direction.
